images.observations: Camera follows original south entry: five differentiated storeys, complete L-shaped roof and continuous coping; no black corner or missing wall apparent. South details remain explicitly estimated.
Original south recessed door, clean frame junctions without square coplanar artifacts, clear leaf bottom and finite local approach. Narrow wall-base shadow remains away from finite support.
Full concave cap, including reentrant corner, visibly continuous. No black triangular gaps or rim-corner spots. North cornice projects as expected.

This view exposes the photo-based north facade: three bays, shortened fifth tier, tall first-floor order, center pediment, stone balcony and right-hand Ionic porch. Internal corner/common walls fully closed.
Footprint fits adjoining terrace and western low neighbor; no obvious shared-wall breakthrough or unfilled roof area. This camera favors the south context rather than the heritage north face.

North porch feet visibly bear on finite support; shafts meet entablature, entablature meets balcony underside. Door frame/capital joints clean. Dark narrow line at recessed leaf bottom retained as a nonblocking contact-shadow observation; numerical support/threshold audit belongs to coordinator.

nonblocking_observations: A narrow dark strip is visible at recessed north door bottom; porch feet and finite support look connected. Render alone cannot certify threshold contact; coordinator numeric audit is required.
